floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

fgw.what: displacement interpolation between the brackets (fused Gromov-Wasserstein coupling, proper rotation, McCann moves) with a mixture of real cells of both, scaled to the embryo size rule

fgw_bluenoise.what: fgw with its drawn positions relaxed towards even local density inside the same cloud (discrete Lloyd steps over the interpolation's pool), then put back at the drawn cloud's centroid and RMS radius
fgw_bluenoise.rule: blue-noise relaxation: RELAX_STEPS discrete Lloyd steps, each moving every drawn cell to the draw-weighted centroid of the pool positions (every cell of both brackets at its moved place, weighted by its chance of being drawn) nearer to it than to any other drawn cell (a cell without one stays); the relaxed cloud is then put back at the drawn cloud's centroid and RMS radius, so the count and the size rule's size are unchanged

fgw_depthdraw.what: fgw with each bracket's real cells drawn with weights lib^lam, lam putting the drawn bracket's weighted median depth at the interpolated stage's predicted depth; no counts edited, the bracket counts fgw's
fgw_depthdraw.rule: depth-shaped draw: each bracket's rows are drawn without replacement with probability proportional to lib^lam (lib: a cell's library size, as DEPTH_RULE reads it), lam solved so that the weights put equal mass on the bracket's cells below and above DEPTH_RULE's target, i.e. the weighted median depth sits at the target; lam = 0, and the bracket keeps the uniform draw as it is, when its cells already split evenly about the target or its depths do not vary; no cell's counts are edited and each bracket's count is the mixture's own
fgw_depthdraw.target: depth: the interpolated stage's median counts per cell = exp((1 - t) log d_before + t log d_after), d = a bracket's median counts per cell over all its cells; cells of a bracket deeper than that are binomially thinned by target / d (panel genes and the rest of the library alike), a shallower bracket's cells are left as they are
